reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF50+
reviews.text: Excellent SPF product, not heavy or sticky. Absorbs well and leaves no white residue. I'll definitely order more. Plus, the Alle formula doesn't cause any breakouts and soothes the skin. Another example: I was at the beach and applied another Israeli-made cream to my body, but this SPF to my face, and my entire body burned except my face.
reviews.zh: 超棒嘅防曬產品，唔厚重亦唔黏笠。吸收得好，唔會留低白色殘留物。我一定會再回購。Alle 配方亦唔會引致爆瘡，仲有舒緩皮膚嘅效果。另一個例子：我去沙灘嘅時候，身體搽咗另一隻以色列製造嘅乳霜，但塊面就搽咗呢款防曬，結果全身曬傷，只有塊面冇事。

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF50+
reviews.text:
I like it . I’ve been using this SPF product for several weeks now, and I’m genuinely impressed with the results. The texture is lightweight and smooth, so it spreads easily across the skin without leaving a greasy or sticky feeling. One of the biggest advantages for me is that it absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave a white cast, which can often be a problem with sunscreens. It works perfectly under makeup and keeps my skin feeling hydrated throughout the day.

I also noticed that even after spending hours outside in sunny weather, my skin stayed protected and I didn’t experience redness or irritation. The formula feels gentle and suitable for sensitive skin, and it never clogged my pores or caused breakouts. Another thing I appreciate is the pleasant, subtle scent that isn’t overpowering.

Overall, this SPF has become an essential part of my daily skincare routine. It combines effective sun protection with comfort and skincare benefits, making it a product I would definitely recommend t
reviews.zh:
我鍾意呢款產品。我用咗呢款防曬幾個星期，真係覺得效果一流。質地輕盈又滑，輕鬆就搽得開，唔會有油膩或者黏笠嘅感覺。對我嚟講最大嘅優點係佢吸收得好快，唔會有泛白嘅問題——呢個通常都係防曬嘅通病。搽完化妝都好服貼，成日都保持到皮膚有保濕感覺。

我仲留意到，就算喺猛烈太陽下面暴曬幾個鐘，皮膚都有好好嘅保護，冇泛紅或者敏感。配方溫和，敏感肌都適合，而且從未堵塞我嘅毛孔或者引致爆瘡。仲有樣嘢我都好欣賞，就係佢有種怡人、低調嘅香味，唔會太搶。

整體嚟講，呢款防曬已經成為我每日護膚程序嘅必備品。佢結合咗有效嘅防曬同護膚嘅舒適感，係一款我一定會推薦畀其他人嘅t

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF50+
reviews.text:
THE LOVE OF MY LIFE! I don’t see myself changing this sunscreen for any other product. I always have to keep a stock of it because it’s the best thing that has happened to me. 

It has a bit *teeny tiny bit* of smell but it reminds me of the beach and aloe (lol) so it's a good one.
 It doesn't leave you with a white face which is AMAZING! I love the glow it gives to my face, it makes it look so healthy and doesn't feel oily or heavy, it's just perfect <3
reviews.zh:
我嘅一生最愛！我唔會換其他防曬產品。我一定要囤貨，因為佢係我人生中遇過最棒嘅嘢。

佢有少少*非常少少*嘅味道，但係令我想起沙灘同蘆薔（笑），所以都幾好。
佢唔會令你塊面白成一片，超正！我好鍾意佢畀到我塊面嘅光澤感，望落好健康，又唔會油膩或者厚重，真係完美 <3

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF50+
reviews.text: I got this for my roommate because I am trying to get him to wear sunscreen consistently. He sweats easily and so it can be difficult for him to find a product that doesn’t make his face feel oily or sweat more. He said he really likes the texture of this product and how it wears throughout the day. This is the second bottle I’ve gotten him because he will actually wear it!! Now if only I can get him to reapply lol.
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢個畀我室友，因為我想佢養成日日搽防曬嘅習慣。佢成日出汗，所以好難搵到一款唔會令佢塊面油膩或者再多出汗嘅產品。佢話佢真係好鍾意呢款產品嘅質地，仲有佢用成日之後嘅貼服感。呢個已經係我買畀佢嘅第二枝，因為佢真係肯用！！如果可以再令佢記得補搽就好啦（笑）。

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF50+
reviews.text: Personally I love it me and my use it she has combination skin and I have dry and sensitive skin it dries up super fast and if you are wondering if it leaves a white cast IT DOES NOT which is why I love it my skin gets super hot and red when I used any products and this sunscreen did not do that I would recommend to anyone but mostly to dry and sensitive skin so I don't really know about oily skin but would recommend 😊
reviews.zh: 個人嚟講我就超愛。我同佢都用緊，佢係混合性皮膚，我係乾性加敏感肌。佢乾得好快，如果你想知會唔會泛白——完全唔會，呢個就係我鍾意佢嘅原因。我用任何產品皮膚都會變得超熱同泛紅，但呢款防曬就唔會。我會推薦畀任何人，但特別推薦畀乾性同敏感肌嘅人，所以油性肌方面我真係唔太清楚，但都會推薦 😊

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF50+
reviews.text:
Pro: Absorbs easily and feels moisturizing. I have dry skin so it works.
Con: I'm not so sure about how effective it is at sun protection. Also it may not be best those who are not dry skin type.
reviews.zh:
優點：容易吸收，感覺保濕。我係乾性肌所以啱用。
缺點：我對佢嘅防曬效果有啲保留。同埋可能唔係最適合非乾性肌嘅人。

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe Soothing Sun Cream SPF50+
reviews.text:
I have combination/oily skin with seborrheic dermatitis.
I have just finished my first bottle and purchased another. It is a great sun cream, with no white cast/ white finish. It is quite similar to a moisturiser and provides extra hydration to my skin. It does tend to become slightly more oily on my forehead and chin, but it is a slight shine rather than oily. I wouldn't recommend it if you have oily skin, but it is great for combination, normal and even dry skin.
reviews.zh:
我有混合性／油性肌膚，仲有脂溢性皮炎。
我啱啱用完第一枝，已經再買多一枝。呢枝防曬好正，完全冇泛白／白色妝效。佢幾似保濕霜，幫皮膚補水。不過搽完之後，額頭同下巴會變得稍為油亮，但其實只係輕微光澤，唔算真正油。我唔建議油性肌用，但混合性、中性同乾性肌用就一流。
